articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures

articles.title: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is building a new programming language for the network
articles.snippet: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date.
